displayName: Change or delete link to language pack download site (User)
description:
This policy setting affects the language download link under the display and help language section.

If you enable this policy setting you, you may enter the URL to another location where language packs may be downloaded.

If you disable this policy setting the URL will be removed.

If you do not configure this policy setting, the URL will remain available and point to the language pack download site on Office.com.
